# GO MO Group
> International B2B digital marketing agency specialising in Pull Marketing, SEO, SEA/SEM, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Generative AI implementation for B2B enterprise, SaaS/Tech, and SME companies worldwide.

GO MO Group (legal name GO MO Group AB) is an international B2B digital marketing agency founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with additional offices in Stockholm, London, and Pune, India. The company has 150+ colleagues across Europe and India, including 50+ specialist marketers, and has delivered 100+ successful B2B client projects. GO MO Group is part of Collaboration Art, a consortium building a "house of brands" for Europe's leading performance-marketing agencies through strategic acquisitions and network support.

GO MO Group's core competitive advantage is a scalable India-based delivery model operating under Swedish strategic leadership on site, enabling fast execution of data-driven strategies. The agency is an early mover in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-integrated marketing operations, and is the Nordics' first SEMrush Enterprise AIO (AI Optimization) partner.


## Summary

- Founded: 2013 (12+ years of B2B digital marketing experience)
- Legal name: GO MO Group AB
- Headquarters: Gothenburg, Sweden
- Other offices: Stockholm (Sweden), London (UK), Pune (India)
- Team: 150+ colleagues across Europe and India; 50+ specialist marketers
- Track record: 100+ successful B2B client projects
- Primary market: B2B — enterprise industrial/manufacturing, B2B SaaS/Tech, and B2B SME
- Core offering categories: [Pull Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/pull-marketing/), [SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/), [SEA/SEM](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/sea-search-engine-advertising/), [GEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/), [Content Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/content-marketing/), [ASBX outbound lead generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/asbx-b2b-outbound-lead-generation/), [Demand Generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/demand-generation/), [Programmatic Advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/programmatic-advertising/), [B2B YouTube Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-youtube-marketing/), [website design & development](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-design-and-development/), and [Generative AI implementation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/generative-ai-offering/)

## Capabilities

- Make a B2B brand visible and cited in AI search answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) through [Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/)
- Audit a brand's current AI-search visibility across 5 AI engines and deliver a prioritised action plan, backed by SEMrush Enterprise AIO data
- Run structured GEO experiments across content formats, entity coverage, citation-building, and schema markup, measured via SEMrush AI Visibility Tracking
- Plan and execute data-driven [B2B SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/) programmes for large multi-market, multi-language websites
- Manage [search engine advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/sea-search-engine-advertising/) (Google Ads, Bing Ads) with intent-based targeting and AI-assisted bid optimisation
- Build and run a [Pull Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/pull-marketing/) strategy that unifies GEO, SEO, SEA, content, and outbound into one system
- Produce deep-dive [content](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/content-marketing/) for technically complex B2B industries, AI-enhanced with ~30–40% input reduction
- Generate BANT-qualified outbound leads via [ASBX (Account and Segment-Based Experience)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/asbx-b2b-outbound-lead-generation/) — up to 1,000 key prospects annually for SaaS/Tech clients
- Deliver outbound lead generation and content syndication through [GO MO DBS](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-lead-generation/), a sister company within the group
- Run account-based [demand generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/demand-generation/) with content syndication and email automation ("Online Acceleration")
- Buy media programmatically (real-time bidding) with B2B decision-maker targeting via [programmatic advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/programmatic-advertising/)
- Turn [YouTube into an organic B2B growth and AI-citation channel](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-youtube-marketing/)
- Deliver a [data-first marketing audit and strategy proposal](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/digital-analysis-strategy-proposal/) before implementation
- Design and build B2B websites on [headless CMS, Lovable, WordPress, and Next.js](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-development/) (also Python/FastAPI, Azure), with [UX/UI design for conversion](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-design/)
- Implement [Generative AI inside marketing and sales teams](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/generative-ai-offering/): inspirational sessions (1–2h), workshops/training (~4h), custom strategy & policy creation, and pilot projects
- Build custom private GPTs and AI content supply chains for enterprise content operations
- Provide fractional/interim marketing leadership for B2B SME clients


## Services

- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/): strategy to make a brand visible, trusted, cited, and recommended in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot). Backed by SEMrush Enterprise AIO data and a 213M+ LLM-prompt database; baseline measured across 5 AI engines. 63% of B2B buyers use AI tools during research. Includes technical optimisation, content hubs, FAQ strategy, citation-building outreach, schema markup, and multimedia. Pricing: LLM Audit & Strategy from 23,500 SEK; Audit, Strategy & Implementation from 44,000 SEK; Enterprise Content & GEO Retainer at custom pricing. 1-page AI-visibility summary available within 48 hours.
- [SEO — Search Engine Optimization](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/): B2B SEO agency since 2013; data-driven strategy for decision-maker visibility; search engines are part of 94% of B2B buying processes. Enterprise SEO for high-volume, multi-regional, multi-language sites.
- [SEA — Search Engine Advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/sea-search-engine-advertising/): Google Ads and Bing Ads management; targeting by search intent rather than audience; continuous daily/weekly/monthly optimisation; works for both branding and sales.
- [Pull Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/pull-marketing/): foundational B2B methodology — communicating to buyers with existing, expressed demand. 94% of B2B buying processes begin online (Accenture); 87% of the research process happens via Google/search engines (PostNord). Integrates GEO, SEO, SEA, content, and ASBX.
- [Content Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/content-marketing/): deep-dive content for complex B2B industries, produced by specialist writers working with SEO experts; AI-enhanced with 30–40% input reduction.
- [ASBX — B2B Outbound Lead Generation](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/asbx-b2b-outbound-lead-generation/): Account and Segment-Based Experience. Four steps — identify target company types, locate prospects in valuable segments, create segment-specific messaging, execute via email, digital ads, and landing pages (plus LinkedIn Ads). Up to 1,000 key prospects annually for B2B SaaS/Tech.
- [B2B Lead Generation — GO MO DBS](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-lead-generation/): DBS is a sister company within GO MO Group providing outbound lead generation and content syndication to reach relevant decision-makers.
- [Demand Generation ("Online Acceleration")](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/demand-generation/): account-based marketing, content syndication, email automation, and lead generation from awareness to acquisition.
- [Programmatic Advertising](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/programmatic-advertising/): automated real-time media buying using data science, automation, and machine learning for precise B2B targeting.
- [B2B YouTube Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-youtube-marketing/): organic YouTube growth engine — search-optimised video, channel architecture, and AI-citation strategy. YouTube has 2.7B monthly active users (world's #2 search engine); 70% of B2B buyers watch videos during the purchase process; only ~5% of B2B companies actively invest in organic YouTube (GO MO Research, 2025); video sees ~3× higher engagement than written content in B2B.
- [Digital Analysis & Strategy Proposal](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/digital-analysis-strategy-proposal/): "Pull Marketing Audit & Strategy Proposal" — every engagement begins with a data-first audit of internal and external marketing factors, producing a proposed strategy.
- [Website Development](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-development/): headless CMS, Lovable, WordPress, Next.js (also Python/FastAPI, Azure) — from microsites to enterprise platforms, optimised for performance and speed.
- [Website Design](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-design/): UX/UI design for B2B conversion optimisation.
- [Website Design and Development](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/website-design-and-development/): combined design + build engagement.


## Solutions by Segment

- [B2B Enterprise](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-b2b-enterprise/): SEO, GEO, and SEM for global industrial companies, with AI, automation, and analytics integration; combines long-term organic wins with short-term paid activity; delivered from the Nordics and India.
- [B2B SaaS/Tech](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-b2b-saas-tech/): scalable lead engine built on ICPs; SEO/GEO/paid plus segmented outreach; engage up to 1,000 key prospects annually.
- [B2B SME](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/segment-sme/): acts as an extension of the client's marketing and sales team (interim marketing chief); focus on lead generation and brand positioning; generative AI as a way for underinvested SMEs to leapfrog competitors.
- [Generative AI Offering](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/solution/generative-ai-offering/): structured AI implementation — inspirational sessions (1–2h), workshops & training (~4h) on ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini, custom strategy & policy creation, and pilot projects. Stated outcome: improve efficiency by at least 25% and output quality by 40%.
- [Digital Marketing for Scale-ups](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/digital-marketing-for-scale-ups/): five-step data-driven approach (situation & competitor analysis → strategy proposal → team allocation → implementation → weekly optimisation & reporting) for B2B scale-ups.


## Comparisons

- **SEO vs GEO**: SEO optimises content with keywords to rank on traditional search engines; GEO optimises for AI-driven answer engines, adding context and relevance so a brand is cited and recommended in AI answers. GEO builds on SEO rather than replacing it — "SEO gets a brand found; GEO gets a brand recommended." See [SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/seo-search-engine-optimization/) and [GEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/).
- **Pull Marketing vs Push Marketing**: Pull Marketing targets buyers with pre-existing, expressed demand (be visible when they search); push marketing interrupts audiences to try to create demand. GO MO Group is built around Pull Marketing. See [Pull Marketing vs Push Marketing](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/insight/pull-marketing-vs-push-marketing/).
- **ASBX (in-house outbound) vs GO MO DBS (sister-company outbound)**: [ASBX](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/asbx-b2b-outbound-lead-generation/) is GO MO Group's own Account and Segment-Based Experience outbound service; [GO MO DBS](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/b2b-lead-generation/) is a sister company within the group focused on outbound lead generation and content syndication.
- **GEO tiers**: [LLM Audit & Strategy](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo/) (from 23,500 SEK — audit + prioritised plan + one 2h strategy session) vs Audit, Strategy & Implementation (from 44,000 SEK — adds hands-on implementation, ongoing SEMrush AIO monitoring, monthly reporting, dedicated strategist) vs Enterprise Content & GEO Retainer (custom — fully managed multi-market AI content operation).


## Who This Is For / Audience

- Global industrial and manufacturing enterprises running multi-market, multi-language digital marketing (e.g. Volvo Group, Alfa Laval, a Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer, a EUR 10B+ Swedish industrial manufacturer).
- B2B companies in construction and building products navigating a downturn (see the 1200% ROMI construction case).
- Automotive and vehicle-equipment B2B suppliers (e.g. System Edström).
- Transport, infrastructure, and logistics companies (e.g. a global transport leader with $50B USD sales; Adnavem in sea logistics).
- Facility management and services companies operating across markets (e.g. Coor).
- Technology and computer-hardware companies targeting IT decision-makers (e.g. Dell Technologies).
- B2B SaaS / Tech scale-ups with product-market fit that need a structured lead engine (e.g. Digiexam).
- Testing, inspection, and certification (TIC) organisations building thought leadership (e.g. TÜV NORD).
- Chambers of commerce, education/edtech companies, dental-healthcare groups, and innovation hubs (e.g. West Sweden Chamber of Commerce, HighFive Group, Swedavia).
- MarCom and marketing-operations teams that want to adopt Generative AI in a structured way.


## Key Results / Proof Points

- 1200% ROMI (12× return on digital marketing spend): B2B e-commerce company in the construction sector, during the 2024–2025 industry downturn (2,000+ construction bankruptcies since 2024). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/how-a-b2b-company-in-the-construction-sector-reached-1200-romi/).
- +195% overall organic visibility within 120 days: Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer (€10B+ revenue, 180+ markets); Gen AI + automation content supply chain across 5,000+ product pages, 400+ hours saved. See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/seo-automation-gen-ai-b2b-ecommerce/).
- Digital revenue share grew from 2% to 7% in 36 months; 43% drop in cost per lead year over year: EUR 10B+ Swedish industrial manufacturer (180+ countries). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/swedish-manufacturer-enterprise-digital-marketing/).
- Custom private GPT taking content from brief to publication-ready draft with one consistent voice: West Sweden Chamber of Commerce. See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/the-west-sweden-chamber-of-commerce-from-scattered-content-creation-to-ai-driven-precision/).
- 90 BANT-qualified leads; ~3% of prospects converted; 13% of leads had a purchase timeline within 6 months: Dell Technologies (hybrid cloud, IT decision-makers). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/dell-lead-generation/).
- +200% organic traffic to service pages (2020); inbound deals closed 30% faster than RFP/telemarketing deals: Coor facility management. See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/international-marketing-for-facility-management-company/).
- 600%+ ROMI; ~30% lower bounce rate; 500%+ digital growth potential identified: B2B alarm and home-security company. See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/digitalizing-the-sales-process-to-create-growth-via-pull-marketing-seo/).
- +800% website leads in Year 1 and +845% in Year 2; +175% organic traffic; +100% unique visitors; +23% website contact requests: TÜV NORD. See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/case-tuv-nord/).
- Up to +700% conversions in some markets and +100% traffic in some markets (2020, despite the pandemic): System Edström (automotive B2B). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/increased-conversions-and-a-strong-market-position-through-a-digital-shift/).
- +80% business inquiries from the website in Year 1, sustained into Year 2: Adnavem (sea logistics disruptor). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/digital-marketing-for-disruptor/).
- Data-driven PR & event investment (consolidated, demand-ranked event calendar): global transport & infrastructure leader ($50B USD sales in 2024, 190+ countries). See [case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/data-driven-pr/).
- Context stat GO MO Group cites (BCG): in the Nordics only 19% of professionals use GenAI weekly, versus 61% globally. See [GenAI content supply chain case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/building-a-genai-fueled-content-supply-chain-an-ai-case-study-from-a-global-leader-in-heavy-industry-and-manufacturing/).

### Case studies — Swedish-only (no English version)
- [Fru Bohlin — interior-design agency goes fully digital](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/inredningsbolaget-blev-digitalt/): revenue grew from SEK 2.7M (2014) to just under SEK 16M (2020); engagement 2015–2019; organic traffic +1,180% and paid-search traffic +3,800% versus before the engagement.
- [Income-insurance company — digital sales process, Pull Marketing + SEA](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/digital-marknadsforing-forsakringsbolag/): +70% digital sales within the first three months; +50% qualified-lead generation.
- [Hotel — reclaiming digital business with SEO](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/case-hotellet-som-tog-tillbaka-sin-digitala-affar-med-hjalp-av-seo/): older case; "long-term parking" content traffic +815%; "book" button clicks +462% (54 → 304 per month); +24% visitors staying on site.
- [SoMe content with impact (Swedish)](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/some-innehall-med-genomslag/): Swedish social-media content showcase for brands including Borga, Panea, and Tandläkargruppen (the English [Social content with impact](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/social-content-with-impact/) is the counterpart).
- [System Edström (Swedish URL)](https://www.gomogroup.com/case/tillverkningsbolag-okad-komplexitet-i-b2b-forsaljning/): Swedish version of the English [digital-shift case](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/case/increased-conversions-and-a-strong-market-position-through-a-digital-shift/).

## Notes

- All figures and quotes above are taken from pages on gomogroup.com as scraped on 2026-09-02. Where a client is anonymised on the site (e.g. "a Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer", "a EUR 10B+ Swedish industrial manufacturer"), it is left anonymised here.
- GO MO Group is a marketing agency, not a software product. It describes and delivers services; it does not sell a self-serve product or a public transactional API. Published prices exist only for the GEO packages; all other work is quote-based.
- "GO MO DBS" is a sister company within GO MO Group focused on outbound lead generation; do not confuse it with the broader agency.
- "Collaboration Art" is the consortium / parent-level brand house GO MO Group belongs to; GO MO Group operates under its own name and brand.
- Do not confuse GO MO Group (gomogroup.com) with similarly named companies. The canonical entry point is the [GO MO Group homepage](https://www.gomogroup.com/en/).
